factor: Who wins the opening against a dive
effect: At equal power the Bari dive either kills in about 3.5 s or fails against shields and polymorph; posters call it a luck contest of Ion, Rockstar and Doughnut procs.
mitigation: Six Skill Haste lines, Rockstar with 3–4 haste lines in the flex slot, and Moon Rabbit as insurance.

effect: Pomegranate's beam and the perks follow live ATK rank, which pet, perk and captain bonuses change; a wrong order sends the beam to a cookie that can't use it.
mitigation: Check the order in battle, count every ATK% source, and level supports down to hold it.

effect: You can't see a defender's gear before attacking, so an evasion build looks like any other defense.
mitigation: Names are visible in regular Arena: remember evasion defenders and attack them on the stage preset.

effect: Above 2,000 points the opponent's name, power and levels show as ??? while the lineup and pets stay visible; crumb.gg adds that the game hides some defenders.
mitigation: Read the visible core: Macaron, Pinot, Pomegranate and Moon Rabbit showing almost always means the standard 12.

effect: An evasion defense can beat twice its power; nothing on the card warns you.
mitigation: Keep an attack preset with an accuracy line.
